name: Purchase Orders - PO attachment and approval
description: Verifies purchase order management: PO attachment to orders, document upload, approval workflow, and status tracking

planSteps.description: Assert that POs list shows with status (pending, approved, rejected) and order references
Click 'New PO' and select an existing order
Upload a PO document (PDF) and enter PO reference number, amount, and vendor
Submit the PO and verify it is attached to the order with 'pending_approval' status
Approve the PO and verify status changes and order is updated with PO reference
